pages.delivered_text:
“Look, Daddy!
Pearl Castle!”
pages.previous_text:
“Look, Daddy!
Pearl Castle!”

pages.delivered_text:
The plane landed at Sky Lagoon.
Pearl Castle was close by.
pages.previous_text:
The plane landed at Sky Lagoon.
Pearl Castle was close by.

pages.delivered_text:
“Let’s look inside,
Daddy,” said Roshan.
pages.previous_text:
“Let’s look inside,
Daddy,” said Roshan.

pages.delivered_text:
“Oh, what a mess!
Where do we start?”
pages.previous_text:
Inside, dust covered the floor.
“It’s SO messy!” said Roshan.
“Where do we start?”

pages.delivered_text:
Sniff, sniff! The big door was stuck.
“We’ll come back!” promised Roshan.
pages.previous_text:
Sniff, sniff!
Someone was sniffling behind a big shell door.
“Hello?” said Roshan. But the door was stuck.
“We’ll come back!” she promised.

pages.delivered_text:
Daddy gave her a duster and two sponges.
“One little job at a time!”
pages.previous_text:
Daddy gave her a duster and two sponges.
“One little job at a time,” said Daddy.

pages.delivered_text:
Splash, splash!
The dust bunny wanted to play.
Gunk went everywhere!
pages.previous_text:
A dust bunny splashed in the dirty bath.
Splash, splash! Gunk went everywhere!
The little bunny just wanted to play.

pages.delivered_text:
First, the sink!
Round and round went Roshan’s sponge.
pages.previous_text:
Roshan started with one little job: the sink.
Round and round went her sponge!

pages.delivered_text:
The bunny was out.
Roshan pulled
the plug.
Swish! Scrub, scrub!
pages.previous_text:
The dust bunny hopped out, and Roshan pulled the plug.
Out went the
dirty water!
She scrubbed
the tub.
Scrub, scrub!

pages.delivered_text:
The bath was clean!
Now the bunny could play.
Far away: sniff, sniff.
pages.previous_text:
Soon the bath was sparkling clean.
Now the dust bunny had a good place to play!
Far away, someone went sniff, sniff.

pages.delivered_text:
Rumi was stuck in gunk.
“Can you help me?”
pages.previous_text:
Rumi was stuck under the gunk.
She needed help!

pages.delivered_text:
“I’ll help!” said Roshan.
Scoop, scoop!
pages.previous_text:
“I’ll help!” said Roshan.
Scoop, scoop!

pages.delivered_text:
Rainbow colors
peeked through the gunk.
pages.previous_text:
Rainbow colors
peeked through the gunk.

pages.delivered_text:
Whoosh!
The waterfall turned rainbow!
pages.previous_text:
Whoosh! The waterfall turned rainbow!
The pool was magic.
Its rainbow had been hiding under the gunk!

pages.delivered_text: Out came the cup! Out splashed the water!
pages.previous_text:
A cup was stuck in the fountain.
Roshan pulled it free. Whoosh!

pages.delivered_text:
The gunk washed away.
Up came Rumi, free at last!
pages.previous_text:
The gunk washed away. Up came Rumi!
She had lived in Pearl Castle for hundreds of years.
Now she was free!

pages.delivered_text:
Rumi hugged Roshan.
“Thank you! Call if you need help!”
pages.previous_text:
“You helped me!” said Rumi.
She gave Roshan a great big hug.
“If you ever need help, just call!”

pages.delivered_text:
Chirp, chirp!
“Someone in the playroom
needs help!” said Roshan.
pages.previous_text: Chirp, chirp! A worried little chirp came from the playroom. “Someone needs help!” said Roshan.

pages.delivered_text:
Two bunnies wanted to play,
but Baby Eagle was stuck under them.
pages.previous_text:
Two dust bunnies sat on Baby Eagle.
They just wanted to play, but he was stuck!
“I’ll help!” said Roshan.

pages.delivered_text:
She gently brushed one bunny away,
then the other.
pages.previous_text:
She gently brushed one bunny away,
then the other.

pages.delivered_text:
Baby Eagle was free!
Chirp, chirp!
pages.previous_text:
Baby Eagle was free!
“Chirp, chirp!” he said happily.
“Let’s all play gently,” said Roshan.

pages.delivered_text:
Paints away. Scrub, scrub!
“One little job at a time!”
pages.previous_text:
In the art room, Roshan put the paints in their
places. She scrubbed the table. Scrub, scrub!
“One little job at a time,” she sang.

pages.delivered_text:
“We’re back!”
Sparkles from the clean rooms reached the door.
Click! AH-CHOO!
pages.previous_text: Sparkles flew from every clean room to the big shell door. Click! Roshan kept her promise. Behind the door, someone sneezed... AH-CHOO!

pages.delivered_text:
Grand Puff sneezed.
AH-CHOO! Dust flew.
He didn’t feel well.
pages.previous_text:
It was Grand Puff, the biggest dust bunny of all!
Every sneeze puffed out more dust.
He did not feel well.

pages.delivered_text:
“He’s too big to wash alone.
Can you help me?” called Roshan.
pages.previous_text:
Roshan wasn’t mad. “I’ll help!” she said.
But Grand Puff was too big to wash alone.
“Can you help me?” she called.

pages.delivered_text:
Daddy, Rumi and Baby Eagle helped Roshan.
Scrub, scrub! They washed Grand Puff together.
pages.previous_text:
“We’ll help!” said Daddy and Rumi.
“Chirp, chirp!” said Baby Eagle.
Together, they washed Grand Puff. Scrub, scrub!

pages.delivered_text:
Soft bubbles covered Grand Puff.
Rainbow colors peeked through!
pages.previous_text:
Soft bubbles covered Grand Puff.
Then rainbow colors peeked through the bubbles!

pages.delivered_text:
POP! Out jumped Grand Puff!
Down fell the dust.
pages.previous_text:
POP! Grand Puff sprang out, rainbow bright!
The dust fell away.

pages.delivered_text:
Down came Grand Puff, soft and small.
“I feel all better!”
pages.previous_text:
Down came Grand Puff, soft and small.
“I feel all better!” he said.

pages.delivered_text:
Pearl Castle was clean!
Friends can do big jobs together.
pages.previous_text:
The art room was tidy.
Pearl Castle was clean again!
It was a big job, but friends can do big jobs together!

pages.delivered_text:
“Sorry about the dust,” said Grand Puff.
“Everyone needs help sometimes,” said Roshan.
pages.previous_text:
“Sorry about all the dust,” said Grand Puff.
“That’s okay,” said Roshan.
“You just needed help. Everyone needs help sometimes!”

pages.delivered_text:
“Come snuggle!” said Roshan.
There was room for everyone.
pages.previous_text: “Come and rest with us!” said Roshan. There was room for everyone, even the dust bunnies. They curled up together and fell asleep.
